annotations.annotation_text: Page 592 opens Book 4, Chapter 1 ("The Ricorso — Dawn") during the Ricorso (The Return) phase. This passage continues dawn breaking over Dublin Bay, St. Kevin bathing at Glendalough, St. Patrick vs. the Archdruid Balkelly, ALP's dissolving final monologue into the sea, featuring St. Kevin, St. Patrick, Balkelly, ALP. The nocturnal dream-narrative layers Dublin topography, world mythology, and linguistic alchemy into polysemic prose.
